answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, agents register through recursive cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Operating like a verifiable atlas of agent provenance, the network maps identity depth while keeping private keys hidden. A lantern of zk-attestation exposes unauthorized clones, forcing each additional identity in a swarm to deposit exponentially escalating stake. When an adversary unleashes a gale of synthetic actors, exponential capital exhaustion rapidly drains their funds, ensuring superlinear economic defense.
